mission.label: Mission
mission.definition: An enduring public purpose or organizational responsibility.

outcome.label: Outcome
outcome.definition: A result a mission seeks: the change in the world that shows the work is paying off.

measure.label: Measure
measure.definition: A way to tell how an outcome is going, such as a figure an office already reports.

capability.label: Capability
capability.definition: An ability an organization needs or has: what must be possible.

requirement.label: Requirement
requirement.definition: A condition or behavior that must be true: what a capability has to do or respect.

implementationPattern.label: Implementation pattern
implementationPattern.definition: An example approach that might realize a capability.

resource.label: Resource
resource.definition: Something that helps you learn about an item or act on it, such as a video, a course, or a guide.

solution.label: Solution
solution.definition: An example of how a pattern could be sourced: a product, a platform the agency has, a shared service, or something built.

public-facing.label: Public facing
public-facing.hint: How the public, applicants, vendors, and other agencies reach the office or find what it publishes.

ai-insights.label: AI and insights
ai-insights.hint: Reporting, analytics, and AI that turn the office’s records into insight and suggestions, for staff to act on.

business-applications.label: Business applications
business-applications.hint: The system of record for each kind of work, where it’s tracked and done.

worker-productivity.label: Worker productivity
worker-productivity.hint: What staff write, collaborate, and draft in, alongside the business applications.

connections.label: Connections
connections.hint: Exchanges with government-wide services and other agencies’ systems, such as SAM.gov, Grants.gov, and Treasury’s.

data-records.label: Data and records
data-records.hint: Where the office’s records and content are stored, searched, and kept on their schedules.

security-identity.label: Security and identity
security-identity.hint: Who gets into each system, and a watch on what they do there, under everything else.

processing.label: Processing service
processing.hint: Specialized processing on the records, such as search and review.

infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure.hint: Shared services every system relies on, such as sign-on.

approaches.platform: Extend a platform the agency has

parts.label: What it’s made of
parts.definition: The main pieces of the pattern.

fitsWhen.label: Fits when
fitsWhen.definition: Situations where the pattern is a good fit.

watchFor.label: Watch for
watchFor.definition: Tradeoffs and risks to plan for.

timely.label: Timely
timely.hint: Things happen when they should, and backlogs don’t pile up.

fair-accessible.label: Fair and accessible
fair-accessible.hint: Open to everyone eligible, and judged on the stated rules.

easy-to-use.label: Easy to use
easy-to-use.hint: People can find, use, and get help with the service.

integrity.label: Integrity
integrity.hint: Money and authority go to the right hands, and fraud is prevented.

results.label: Results
results.hint: The mission achieves its purpose, economically.

accountable.label: Accountable
accountable.hint: Decisions hold up, problems get fixed, and concerns can be raised safely.

transparent.label: Transparent
transparent.hint: The work and the spending are open to view.

plan-prepare.label: Plan and prepare
plan-prepare.hint: Setting direction, programs, rules, and readiness.

reach-take-in.label: Reach and take in
reach-take-in.hint: Telling people what’s offered, and taking in requests, applications, reports, and data.

deliver-operate.label: Deliver and operate
deliver-operate.hint: Providing the service, paying, and running the operation.

monitor-correct.label: Monitor and correct
monitor-correct.hint: Watching how things go, enforcing, and resolving disputes and appeals.

report-close.label: Report and close
report-close.hint: Closing out, publishing, reporting, and learning.

checks-controls.label: Checks and controls
checks-controls.hint: Eligibility and identity checks, conflicts of interest, approvals, and payment holds.

decisions-on-record.label: Decisions on the record
decisions-on-record.hint: Documenting what was decided and why, and keeping it.

privacy-security.label: Privacy and security
privacy-security.hint: Protecting information, people’s identities, and access to them.

transparency-reporting.label: Transparency and reporting
transparency-reporting.hint: Publishing, posting, and reporting to oversight bodies.

service-access.label: Service and access
service-access.hint: Notices, help, status, plain language, and access for people with disabilities or limited English.

fairness-due-process.label: Fairness and due process
fairness-due-process.hint: Stated criteria, equal treatment, and rights to appeal, challenge, or be heard.

site.label: Site
site.hint: Program sites and portals to know.

community.label: Community
community.hint: Councils, communities of practice, and forums.

dataset.label: Dataset
dataset.hint: Data to explore, compare, or build on.

tool.label: Tool
tool.hint: Free tools, calculators, and open-source software.

template.label: Template
template.hint: Templates, samples, and checklists to start from.

demo.label: Demo
demo.hint: A working example to see or try.

service.label: Service
service.hint: Help an organization offers, such as an assessment or an implementation.

product.label: Product
product.hint: A product, or a feature of one, that fits.

case-study.label: Case study
case-study.hint: How an agency did it, and what it learned.
